svg.title: The layer operation is the sum over translated signed views divided by the number of signed orientations; translations are summed, not probability averaged. For each view-dependent term, translation covariance changes its anchor-zero value to its value at the translated anchor. Reindex- ing the finite sites by the signed permutation then proves that the low live layer plus the cubic and quartic masked layers is exactly the stipulated kinetic energy. It also proves that the low proxy layer is P o headsp(o, U): signed reframe preserves the sum of squared plane norms, and the orientation count cancels its inverse. Thus both identities used in the reset’s path cancellation come from the original symbol normalization and actual path rows.
